en: Changed mods Claude writes to turn on without asking in auto and bypass modes, even with managed `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` or `allowManagedDomainsOnly`, and not to load in `dontAsk` mode
zh: 变更 Claude 写入的 mod：在自动模式和 bypass 模式下无需询问即可启用，即使设置了托管的 `allowUnsandboxedCommands: false` 或 `allowManagedDomainsOnly`；在 `dontAsk` 模式下不加载
